description: Convert a cooking amount between units. Use when needing exact conversions between same-dimension units; avoid when needing ingredient-specific conversions, use scale_recipe instead.

from.description: Unit to convert from, e.g. cup

ingredient.description: Ingredient name, needed for volume <-> weight, e.g. flour

to.description: Unit to convert to, e.g. g

name: convert_units

conversionFactor.description: The factor used to convert between the units

convertedValue.description: The converted amount in the target unit

error.description: Error message if the conversion failed, e.g. unknown unit or ingredient

fromUnit.description: The unit that was converted from

ingredient.description: The ingredient name used for volume-to-weight conversion, if applicable

toUnit.description: The unit that was converted to

title: Convert units
